_comment: Step 21's sensitive-path denylist — path segments/query keys strongly associated with a one-time, credential-bearing link (password reset, email verification, magic-link login, unsubscribe tokens). Matched case-insensitively against path+query+FRAGMENT before the query-string policy applies, since the credential often lives in the query and, for OAuth/OIDC implicit flows, in the fragment — which is now kept rather than discarded, so the fragment keys here are load-bearing, not theoretical. This list is a starting point, not exhaustive — expand it as real captures surface more patterns; it is deliberately conservative (biased toward over-matching, since dropping a normal reading is far cheaper than storing a live token).
